title: Tourist Season, 2002 · after
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The Monday after the napkin: the tourist from Friday back on the seawall with the napkin in a plastic sleeve, showing it to another tourist. Wood at the far end of the wall, watching himself be shown. He leaves before they look up.

panels.composition: The seawall. A tourist showing a second tourist a napkin in a plastic sleeve. WOOD far along the wall with BARNABY.
